findings.text: §26 explains the pane's failure as "the session host restarts a follower only when the session dispatches. The admit service launched this run, not the session, so nothing brought the pane back", but `dispatch()` asks the session's host for a follower on any cli dispatch at `reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1447-1455` — the call `_launch_queued` makes passes `session` and no `admission_launch` guard is consulted there, so the admit path asks the host as well, and a follower it starts begins with `saw_live` false (`reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:1384-1389`) and so does not settle and exits on an empty population
